purpose: Increase transferable lexical-context evidence using the full existing train partition, with separate background-count and supervised-calibration families.
data: Pinned Tatoeba lm-corpus-v1 train only. Exclude all retained E44 calibration families before counting. Preserve train/dev/test family isolation and exclude full training segments with symmetric substring or one-edit overlap against all existing dev/test TSVs and the known diagnostic TSV. Never use heldout candidate outputs to build counts or vocabulary.
segmentation: Reuse the existing F1 SPLX/3 base projection and deterministic unigram Viterbi Segmenter, max 8 Han per unit, unknown Han as singleton. These inferred boundaries are not reference gold or the exact production decoder lattice.
counts: W2: adjacent segmented word units. CW: last one/two Han characters to the next word or remaining word suffix at every nonfinal character cut. Separate unigram distributions by namespace. No BOS/EOS feature or sentence-end reward. Retain pairs seen in at least two distinct background source families; repeated rows of one family do not satisfy this threshold.
associationFeature: For each retained pair use the positive clipped log likelihood ratio max(0,min(4,log(P_discount(next|context)/P_unigram(next)))). Absolute discount 0.75, unigram alpha 0.1; pruned direct mass goes to backoff. Unseen pairs contribute zero rather than a negative OOV penalty. Sum actual baseline-winning-path W2/CW features divided by sqrt(candidate length). This is a contextual association feature, not a normalized sentence LM.
coverageGate: Before fitting, compare E53 versus full-count known-word-pair coverage on the two known dev domains, ignoring reference labels and rank metrics. Require strictly more eligible states with discriminating pair features in each domain. If this fails, stop without fitting or changing cutoffs.
fit: One nonnegative scalar multiplying the association feature; original candidate scores and all other coefficients stay fixed. E53 current-production calibration groups only, all their families excluded from background counts. Gold cross entropy with 8*tanh(weight*feature/8), ridge 0.001, weight in [0,4], zero initialization, L-BFGS-B maxiter 200 ftol 1e-10 gtol 1e-7. No parameter grid, dev tuning, alternative model selection or retry after quality failure. Freeze scalar and table before rank evaluation.
eligibility: Unchanged first-eight equal-length Han BASE_EXACT/BASE_COMPOSED slot policy. Candidate membership and protected sources remain unchanged; no injected references and no claim to repair missing candidates.
gate: Require convergence, each known dev domain top1/top5 nondecreasing, recall unchanged and character errors nonincreasing, combined top1 strictly increasing, host additional scoring P95 <=100ms, table JSON <=16MiB. Disclose complete-sentence versus oracle-context suffix results and every regression. Only a passing fixed candidate can proceed to independent regression and Android work.
scope: The underlying fixed character LM was previously trained on the full Tatoeba train partition. Separation here is between the new word table and scalar calibration, not a claim that the entire IME has never seen calibration text. Corpus and dictionary licenses/attribution remain attached; preserve rc.7, production assets, original signing material and physical-phone boundary.
